title: RCW 50A.05.010, Definitions (Paid Family and Medical Leave)

passages.question: Is the hourly concrete finishing billed by Tomas Arvelo, an individual, covered employment whose pay belongs on this report?
passages.excerpt: (8)(a) "Employment" means personal service, of whatever nature, unlimited by any employment relationship as known to the common law or any other legal relationship performed for wages ... (b) "Employment" does not include: ... (iv) Services that require registration under chapter 18.27 RCW or licensing under chapter 19.28 RCW rendered by an individual when: (A) The individual has been and will continue to be free from control or direction over the performance of the service, both under the contract of service and in fact; ...
